metadata.policy: Every irregularity, deprecated API field, browser constraint, and unconfirmed data value is documented transparently here and published on pages/flagged-for-review.html. None of these items block deployment; unverified values are intentionally left blank rather than inferred.

items.summary: Initial repository contained only an 11-byte README.md (# Tradebot2)
items.details: At base commit 003447ea92f5fdd7c2ee66558876c99237818f38, the repository had no existing application code, API clients, tests, or documentation. All dashboard code, Python tooling, verified datasets, and documentation were authored cleanly from official Kalshi specifications.

items.summary: Prompt lists both dedicated external-api and legacy demo-api hostnames
items.details: Kalshi's official documentation designates https://external-api.demo.kalshi.co/trade-api/v2 and wss://external-api-ws.demo.kalshi.co/trade-api/ws/v2 as the RECOMMENDED Demo endpoints, while https://demo-api.kalshi.co/trade-api/v2 and wss://demo-api.kalshi.co/trade-api/ws/v2 remain supported legacy shared hosts. Tradebot2 defaults to the recommended external-api hosts and lets users toggle to the legacy host if needed.

items.summary: Market liquidity and liquidity_dollars fields are deprecated and return 0
items.details: Per Kalshi's official API Changelog, liquidity and liquidity_dollars on GET /markets and GET /events return 0. Accurate contract liquidity at each price level MUST be read from GET /markets/{ticker}/orderbook (or batch GET /markets/orderbooks) and WebSocket orderbook_delta using orderbook_fp.yes_dollars and orderbook_fp.no_dollars.
items.blank_or_unverified_field: Static live Demo orderbook depth snapshot (runtime-only)

items.summary: No native 1-second REST candlestick interval exists in Kalshi API
items.details: GET /series/{series_ticker}/markets/{ticker}/candlesticks supports period_interval values of 1 (minute), 60 (hour), and 1440 (day) only. The dashboard's Seconds X-axis view therefore aggregates live ticks client-side (from WebSocket/polling stream or Demo Simulator), while Minutes and Hours map cleanly to Kalshi's native 1-minute and 60-minute candlestick intervals.
items.blank_or_unverified_field: Native 1-second historical REST endpoint (does not exist)

items.summary: Standard browsers cannot attach custom KALSHI-ACCESS-* headers to WebSocket handshakes
items.details: Kalshi's WebSocket API requires signed KALSHI-ACCESS-KEY, KALSHI-ACCESS-TIMESTAMP, and KALSHI-ACCESS-SIGNATURE HTTP headers during the upgrade handshake. Browser WebSocket APIs do not permit custom request headers. Use the included Python client/relay (scripts/kalshi_demo_client.py) for authenticated live WebSocket streaming, or use public REST polling + Simulated Demo Mode directly on static GitHub Pages.

items.summary: Live browser CORS headers on external-api.demo.kalshi.co could not be probed from build sandbox
items.details: Because the build sandbox restricts outbound network access to GitHub, npm, and PyPI, live HTTP OPTIONS/GET CORS headers from https://external-api.demo.kalshi.co/trade-api/v2 were not directly tested. The site automatically attempts live public REST fetches when the user clicks 'Connect Live Demo REST' and gracefully falls back to clearly badged Simulated Demo Mode if blocked by CORS or network error.

items.summary: Demo market prices, volumes, and availability differ from production Kalshi markets
items.details: Kalshi explicitly notes that demo environment prices and market behavior may not reflect real markets, and demo accounts require separate credentials at https://demo.kalshi.co/. Verified catalog volumes shown in topic tables are observed snapshots from official kalshi.com market pages (clearly labeled as Reference Snapshots, not live Demo exchange books).
items.blank_or_unverified_field: Live Demo exchange dollar volume per ticker (runtime-only)

items.summary: Unauthenticated public REST numeric rate limit is not published
items.details: Kalshi documents token budgets for authenticated tiers (default 10 tokens/request, Balance endpoint 1 req/s Basic/Advanced or 5 req/s higher), but does not publish an exact numeric requests/second limit for unauthenticated public requests. The value is left blank in our verified API table.

items.summary: Seven verified Kalshi market entries had no visible dollar volume in official page snippets
items.details: Per strict zero-hallucination policy, dollar volume cells are left blank for KXAAAGASCDAK-26NOV20 (Gas Prices), KXGAMEAWARDS-BAD (Culture), KXBTC70VS100-BTC-26DEC31, KXBTCMAXY-26DEC31, KXCRYPTORETURNY-26 (Crypto), and KXPGATOUR-THRC26, KXPGAMASTERS-26 (Golf) because dollar volume was not directly displayed in the verified official source snapshot.
items.blank_or_unverified_field: Observed dollar volume on 7 market rows

items.summary: Legacy /portfolio/orders mutation endpoints carry a 10x write rate-limit penalty vs V2
items.details: Kalshi's API Changelog states that legacy /portfolio/orders write endpoints cost 10x as many write tokens as the V2 event-order endpoints (POST /portfolio/events/orders). scripts/kalshi_demo_client.py implements V2 order creation by default.

items.summary: Settled markets older than market_settled_ts are archived out of live GET /markets
items.details: To track resolved events through settlement history without missing older outcomes, clients must query GET /historical/cutoff and fetch archived markets/fills/positions from /historical/* endpoints.

items.summary: No Demo API keys or private PEM files are stored in the repository
items.details: Users must generate their own Kalshi Demo API key at https://demo.kalshi.co/ and provide it via environment variables (KALSHI_KEY_ID, KALSHI_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH) for the Python CLI/relay or optional local-only browser session fields.
